title: Giant Revolt Advanced 2 Review + In Depth Gravel Discussion

takeaways.text: C$3,499 or US$2,800, weighing about 21.5 lb (about 9.75 kg); the Advanced Pro models use essentially the same frame with better wheels and cockpit.
Mechanical Shimano GRX 820 2×12 with a 46/30 crank and clutch rear derailleur; Giant favours 2× on the Revolt, which many buyers seek out.
Compliance comes from dropped seatstays and the D-Fuse seatpost; he thinks it is almost overkill when 45 mm tires are run at around 30 psi.
Integrated cable routing through the cockpit looks clean but makes stem and bar changes harder, a negative for riders who tweak fit.
Down-tube storage plus fork and frame cargo mounts; geometry sits in the middle ground between rivals; Giant's press-fit bottom bracket has been reliable and creak-free in his shop's experience.

disclosure: The presenter owns a Canadian bike shop that sells Giant and competing brands.
summary: A shop owner's detailed walkthrough of the 2026 Giant Revolt Advanced 2, which he says is essentially the 2025 bike.
